notes.title: Version 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Ver 1.1 [25 November 2024]
===========================================

Updates:

- Intro has been completely overhauled.
- In-battle status now available for allies and foes alike
- Graphical overhaul. Enhanced lighting, smooth scrolling, cloud overlays & weather effects. 
- New message and menu layouts. Visual item inventory added - affects in-battle inventory system as well.
- Better map visibility, more of the screen is now shown.
- Visible icons - quest NPCs are marked differently from chatter NPCs.
- New weapons, armour and other accessories like skill scrolls and card boosters.
- Rare drops added to many monsters.
- More Challenge difficulty settings, up to a max Danger Level of 28.

notes.title: Version 1.1 update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello my fellow sky-pirates and adventurers, your friendly neighbourhood Kitsu Ud0n here once again to crawl out of her fox den and share some updates!

I'm happy to announce that the version 1.1 update is coming along nicely and will release towards the end of this month, just in time for the Autumn sale ^^

[h3]VERSION 1.1 UPDATES[/h3]

The biggest change is that the intro has been completely overhauled, no more weird dream sequences plus its massive lore dump - the player gets dumped right into the middle of things onboard an airship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/ce009e32bda5d9e6d8ae93a87da182c93e2f34db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/688f54ca4059017a00a873a7161867887fa81209.png[/img]
[i]The skill equip scene has visual icons for better clarity; this applies to the inventory scene as well.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/0cf55350bc84ffd921d4111426cc8749f568614c.png[/img]
[i]Every menu has been given a visual overhaul as well.[/i]

There are some slight story changes but nothing major; I try to keep the narrative relatively simple and leave the lore in the background for players who like stuff like that :3

But that's it for version 1.1's (really) short update.

[h3]SEQUEL UPDATES:[/h3]
I shared some updates a month and a half ago with regards to the sequel (which I promise will be even better than the original game) so here are some new screenshots with original assets drawn by me :3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/5884308ec34056a75fb6ea21e26f7bf58dd12fb4.png[/img]

Instead of a fixed narrative, the player will take on various quests from NPCs and try to uncover the mysteries behind this new skydom, called Liguria. The "gods" (or rather, Divine Beasts in the og Veiled Skies) are angry because the true heir, who has a duty to oversee the protection of these skies, has been missing for over a decade. 

As a result, they are unleashing their fury on the unsuspecting denizens of Liguria, starting with violent tempests in and around Kessel, the first town/starting area.

After the player has cleared Kessel and its surrounding areas [you won't be able to use the Dauntless due to the violent winds], they are free to explore the Ligurian skydom in any manner they see fit.

The battle system has been changed as well, with heavy emphasis on maximizing turn actions and delaying foes. Character builds will be centered around Critical, Evasive or Counter-Attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/0d060a8061f78ec87b01b581ed0e82660df30ed3.png[/img]

Everything is still really early in development so updates will  be few and far in-between. But please look forward to it :D

This is Ud0n signing off!

notes.title: Visual Overhaul in progress!
notes.content:
Hello my fellow sky-pirates and adventurers, your friendly neighbourhood Kitsu here!

Apologies for the radio silence, but I have been hard at work on the visual overhaul for VS, scheduled for a late November release (just before the Autumn sale, yay!). Am sad I could not offer you lovely people a discount for the Turn-based RPG Fest but VS is still a fairly new game. ^^

What you can expect. They say a picture is worth a thousand words, so here's some WIP screens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/d924c7ca7560ce652dd1a4690b972c445af421a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/cf9f6f86d91bcc10ce58cf68b82f9a8bd71232d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/c4b577ce0f6e287d01f5b6a0f39b7f6ecc0d045f.png[/img]

What you can expect in version 1.1:

[list]
[*] In-battle status now available for allies and foes alike
[*] Graphical overhaul. Enhanced lighting, cloud overlays & weather effects. New message and menu layouts.
[*] Better map visibility, more of the screen is now shown.
[*] Visible icons - quest NPCs are marked differently from chatter NPCs.
[*] Party banter for both on-map and in-battle.
[*] New weapons, armour and other accessories like skill scrolls and card boosters.
[*] More Challenge difficulty settings.
[/list]

But that isn't even the most exciting news! Since I now have a dedicated artist helping me, Part II will include side-view battlers and a whole new plethora of features! ^^ Also it's going to look even prettier! I promise to deliver the best possible product, so don't expect a release until at least 2026, ahahaha...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/6d7f7f91172c887da8329d4c4971ee05f08e4104.png[/img]
[i]She's fully animated too, complete with ear flicks and tail swishies![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/6ec693cb68c93253134eed40836c327143685457.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/a7785ace019a386e2fcbf3875bca562c01d1f81b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/9519ca2ba8c1b841558248673f2df4d50c8a933e.png[/img]
[i]All screens are a work-in-progress![/i]

Please look forward to more exciting updates! This is Ud0n signing off!

notes.title: Version 1.01 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello fellow adventurers and sky-pirates![/h2]

Version 1.01 has been released and here is the list of fixes as follows:

First, the title screen for the new version!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/e227e1c64ed01b6094a99dd469af52ce097ac3d5.png[/img]

Now onto the fixes!
[list]
[*] "Walk-on" wall in Yorodama. A good "bad" bug where the player can get the "Brave Suit" early. This has been fixed.
[*] Aya bug" - Depending on how the player enters Katsura's office, Rina may be blocked by Aya and the scene will not continue as normal. This is no
[*] longer the case.
[*] "Akai scene bug" - If the player heads back to the Yoro skydeck, the scene will trigger again. This has been patched as well.
[/list]

The bugged Teleport/Warp Crystals are working as intended and the game will check if you have met the relevant Challenge Quests requirements now.

VS Part II has already begun development! VS is part of a trilogy so I have to move fast!
ETA: Late 2025

[h3]Some features include:[/h3]

[list]
[*] A massive hub-like city.
[*] The player can fly to different islands in their airship.
[*] A forging system
[*] An emblem/sigil system (which can be leveled up)
[*] Equipabble passive abilities
[*] The overall character level cap will be increased to 120. The core combat remains unchanged.
[/list]

Brunswick (early WIP) - hub city
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/5bab414c89f0e5503c4f838733a00d078c17d6aa.jpg[/img]

Dragon Valley (placeholder name)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060792/8731daa09f8fa5677a4a779a51320acff98334a4.jpg[/img]
